requirementFit.summary: REQ-BE-BOT maps to AC-BOT-1/2, EV-BOT-1/2, the single WS-BE-BOT workstream, security gates SEC-BOT-SCOPE/SEC-PROVIDER and the final audit gates; durable idempotent runs, bounded retries/timeouts, authorized chat-scoped search and the local-provider boundary are explicit.

evidenceQuality.summary: EV-BOT-1/EV-BOT-2 are provable by the deterministic sqlite gate (backend/verify.sh in the isolated container plus the focused pytest command, the stage 5-8 receipt pattern) with injectable fake providers, transport and clock; the absent native Ollama is recorded UNAVAILABLE and never converted to PASS.

residualRisk.summary: Round-1 findings (source-message validation incl. the cross-chat hole; duplicate-delivery vs crash-resume disambiguation via CAS + stale window + injectable clock; bot-user bootstrap; FK on-delete pins; forbiddenWrites for consumed files) were all closed in r3 and re-verified by the focused round 2; the one remaining LOW (missing BOT-IDENTITY checklist row) was closed at freeze.

summary: Independent two-round read-only audit of the refrozen stage 9 package. Round 1 (r2) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with two MEDIUM findings (unvalidated source message allowing a cross-chat disclosure through a foreign message_id; a contradiction between never-re-executing duplicates and resuming crashed runs, with no disambiguation mechanism) and LOW findings (bot-user bootstrap unspecified; bot_runs FK on-delete unpinned; consumed files not write-forbidden). Round 1 also verified the architecture as a whole against the real tree: base facts (Chat.is_ai, no User.is_bot, MessageService/ChatService/DocumentService contracts, composition seam, httpx runtime dep), write-set completeness including the models/__init__ and alembic env.py non-issues, the local-only provider boundary and honest UNAVAILABLE policy, and the ALK mechanics (per-attempt artifactPaths, reproducible validation commands, sorted planFiles, launchGate SHA). Round 2 (r3, focused) verified every closure landed exactly as declared - the four source-message validations with a cross-chat integration test, the CAS claim with IntegrityError first-delivery handling, the CHATTY_BOT_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS re-claim window on an injectable clock with attempt++ and an explicit 409 retry_budget_exhausted, the public-auth-API bot bootstrap with bot_user_not_configured steady state, the pinned FK rules and the four added forbidden paths - and confirmed no regression in JSON validity, planFiles inventory or write-set disjointness. Verdict: READY_TO_FREEZE.
